events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, Abbey Road, in the UK on September 26, 1969, and in the US on October 1, 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road iconic cover
angles.copy: That iconic zebra crossing. The Beatles' Abbey Road album dropped this week in '69. What's your favourite track from this masterpiece?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde tribute
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the brilliant Chrissie Hynde! Her distinctive voice and songwriting have given us some timeless tracks with The Pretenders. What's your favourite?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis and Beady Eye frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher tribute
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! From Oasis anthems to his solo hits, he's always delivered pure rock 'n' roll. What's your top track?

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine released 55 years ago
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic second solo album, Imagine, was released in the US on September 9, 1971, and in the UK on October 8, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine album anniversary
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon gave us the timeless 'Imagine' album. A powerful message that still resonates today. Which song from the record moves you the most?

events.title: The original iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple released the first generation iPod, revolutionising portable music, on October 23, 2001.

angles.name: iPod anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? The original iPod launched 25 years ago this month, changing how we listen to music forever. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, Dr. No, on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! 64 years since 007 first hit the big screen with 'Dr. No'. Who's your favourite Bond and what's the best theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today. He was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: John Lennon tribute birthday
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're remembering the profound impact of John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary British comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today. He was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: John Cleese tribute
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is truly timeless. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album anniversary
angles.copy: The Beatles' iconic 'White Album' dropped 58 years ago this month. An incredibly diverse and experimental record. What's your stand-out track from the double LP?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks 36 years since the passing of the legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who died on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury tribute
angles.copy: 36 years ago today, we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice, stage presence, and songwriting continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' Rubber Soul turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album, Rubber Soul, in the UK on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul anniversary
angles.copy: 61 years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal moment in their evolution, showcasing incredible songwriting and new sounds. Which track defines it for you?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic passing of music icon John Lennon, who died on December 8, 1980.

angles.name: John Lennon death anniversary
angles.copy: 46 years ago today, the world lost John Lennon. His legacy of peace, love, and revolutionary music continues to resonate globally. We're playing some of his greatest hits to remember him.
